name: The Beast in Me
s: Since the tragic death of her young son, acclaimed author Aggie Wiggs has receded from public life, unable to write, a ghost of her former self. But she finds an unlikely subject for a new book when the house next door is bought by Nile Jarvis, a famed and formidable real estate mogul who was once the prime suspect in his wife's disappearance. At once horrified and fascinated by this man, Aggie …

paragraphs.text: The Beast in Me is an American psychological crime thriller television series, created by Gabe Rotter for Netflix, starring Claire Danes and Matthew Rhys. Executive producers on the series include Jodie Foster and Conan O'Brien. It premiered on November 14, 2025, and received generally positive reviews from critics and nine nominations at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Limited or Anthology Series, with Rhys winning Outstanding Lead Actor in a Limited or Anthology Series or Movie. Although The Beast in Me was originally billed as a miniseries, it was renewed for a second season in September 2026.
The series follows an author Aggie Wiggs (Danes) who begins writing a book about her new next-door neighbor Nile Jarvis (Rhys), a real estate executive who allegedly killed his wife.

The review aggregator website Rotten Tomatoes reported an 85% approval rating, based on 71 critic reviews, with an average rating of 7.7/10. The website's critics consensus reads: "A cut above the usual murder mystery, The Beast in Me stages a psychological duel that crackles with tension thanks to Claire Danes and Matthew Rhys' superb performances." Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, gave a score of 71 out of 100, based on 29 critics, indicating "generally favorable" reviews.
It has been speculated that the series is based on the life of murderer Robert Durst.
